raw_result.task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear and neatly arrange all light objects in the kitchen, ensuring surfaces are clutter-free and well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Organize and tidy up the living room by clearing light objects and ensuring the area is brightly lit.
central_instructions.R3: Tidy the bedroom by arranging both light and heavy objects, and push any furniture if necessary to ensure the room looks immaculate.
central_instructions.R4: Clear and organize light objects in the bathroom, making sure all surfaces are clean and the area is well-lit.

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the microwave to ensure it is neatly aligned. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Ensure all surfaces are clear and well-lit. (r1_s6)

- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange items neatly on the dresser and shelves. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Push the chair slightly to align it neatly with the wall. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the bedspread and pillows to ensure they are neatly arranged. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]

[10-15 min]

- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bathroom light to ensure the area is brightly lit. (r4_s4)
